lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And here I thought killing 16 was harder for me than it was for you.

lines.text: The young man has apparently undergone a harrowing transformation, and is currently dismantling these demented delinquents, one after the--!

lines.text: Great. Now I can watch us become irrelevant vertically instead of horizontally... What are we even doing here anymore?

lines.text: So what are we gonna call this?

lines.text: 'If he's a Super-Duper Saiyan... then I shall find a way to become a Super-DEE-Duper Saiyan!'

lines.text: I'm gonna call you "Whooping Cough", because you just *devastated* my children!

lines.text: Nothing like a concussion... to really get the blood flowing—!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: The taste of blood in my mouth...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: The sound of my heart in my ears...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: But right now... in this moment...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: The only thing I hate more than it... is *you*.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Because you were right about me.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Scared of what would happen if I snapped...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Afraid that... if I lost it this time... I'd... never come back.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: But I'm not scared anymore, Cell.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Because there's no point in being afraid of the inevitable.

lines.text: All right, Gohan! Think it's time you brought her home!

lines.text: I'm not done ripping the wings off this butterfly.

lines.text: But what? You're gonna give me advice now?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Let me guess... I should let him go so he can be an even better fight later!

lines.text: Wait! I know... I should throw him a god damn Senzu Bean... *and let YOU fight him*!

lines.text: Ah... uh... I... see what you're getting at, Gohan.

lines.text: Then shut up and put on your poncho.

lines.text: 'No, no, no, no, no, no! I can't die to this!'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Because I'll be honest, it's working.

lines.text: Oh, my dear boy. I think I finally realized what I inherited from *you*...

lines.speaker: Semi-Perfect Cell
lines.text: Heh-heh! No, Gohan... It was your *explosive* temper!

lines.speaker: Semi-Perfect Cell
lines.text: You see, in less than a minute from now, I'm going to *burst*... AND TAKE YOU, AND THIS WHOLE WRETCHED WORLD WITH ME!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: So what you're saying is I have less than a minute to kill you.

lines.text: Any attack could set me off!

lines.speaker: Semi-Perfect Cell

lines.speaker: Semi-Perfect Cell
lines.text: So how about you savor the time you have left, before I go "pop"?!

lines.text: HOPE YOU ENJOYED THE CELL GAMES! BYE, EVERYBODY! GOOOOO F*** YOURSELVES!

lines.text: I did exactly what my Dad and Vegeta do...

lines.text: Well... I guess I should go clean up my mess, huh?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: All of you... take it easy.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Fighting is... Well, it makes me happy... and I just thought it would make you happy, too!

lines.text: I want you to know... that that year we spent in the Time Chamber... was the best year of my life.
